clauses.reason: The order states that Executive Order 12834 of January 20, 1993 "is hereby revoked, effective at noon January 20, 2001". The revocation executed itself at that moment, so the command was exhausted by performance on 2001-01-20; EO 12834 remains revoked as an accrued effect, which is not a continuing command of EO 13184. No earlier end is held and no held later instrument names this order.

The sentence states that employees and former employees subject to the commitments in Executive Order 12834 will not be subject to those commitments after the effective date of this order. It states the consequence of the revocation and is exhausted when the revocation took effect at noon on 2001-01-20; the resulting release is an accrued effect, not a continuing command of EO 13184. No earlier end is held.

research_rationale:
EO 13184 (signed 2000-12-28; 66 FR 697, Federal Register of 2001-01-03, FR Doc. 01-255) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13184.txt. Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (2000-12-28, Revocation of Executive Order 12834). Inventory: the authority recital ending 'it is hereby ordered as follows:' (characters 676 to 947, the dossier's clause) is not operative. The order's two operative sentences follow it: the revocation of EO 12834 of January 20, 1993 (Ethics Commitments by Executive Branch Appointees), effective at noon January 20, 2001 (characters 948 to 1101), and the sentence that employees and former employees subject to the commitments in EO 12834 will not be subject to those commitments after the effective date of the order (characters 1103 to 1267). The inventory override replaces the recital with these two clauses. The revocation is self-executing: it was performed by operation of the order at its stated effective moment, so that clause is exhausted by performance on 2001-01-20. The release sentence states the consequence of that revocation; once the revocation took effect nothing remained for EO 13184 to do, so it is exhausted on the same date, and the resulting freedom from the commitments is an accrued effect of the completed revocation and not a continuing command of EO 13184. A by-number search of the held order texts for EO 13184 finds only this order's own text, and the three machine searches record no amendment, revocation or supersession of this order (current-law:usc 0, current-law:ecfr 0, later-events:ofr_catalog 0). The held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF; the PDF page images are not held, so identity (printed number, title, signing date and FR Doc. number) was checked on the text layer against the census register row.

savings.reason: The order has no savings clause. Its consequence, that EO 12834 and the commitments under it no longer bind after noon January 20, 2001, is an accrued effect of the completed revocation and requires no further action by the order. No held source shows any pending matter, exception or later reinstatement of EO 12834 by an instrument naming EO 13184.
